question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct option is **: greener**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage suggests that people are moving out of cities for a **"cleaner"** environment, which implies a **"greener," **more environmentally friendly setting.
 
• **"Greener"** aligns with the contemporary desire for sustainable living environments, often associated with less pollution and more open spaces.

Therefore, the correct option is** "Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Worse"** is the opposite of what the passage implies and contradicts the idea of seeking a better environment.
 
• **"Dark"** does not relate to the environmental context of the passage.
 
• **"Higher" **could imply a greater amount or level of something, but it does not fit the context of environmental quality.
